channel.title: Tunisia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tunisia, every source cited.

item.title: Semia Setti's new novel sells out at Tunis book fair
item.description: The author's second book, "Je suis née à six ans," explores childhood trauma and self-reconstruction.

item.title: Tunisia signs stadium reconstruction contract
item.description: A Chinese consortium will rebuild the El Menzah Olympic Stadium for up to 600 million dinars.

item.title: Tunisia and Russia discuss cooperation after Africa summit
item.description: Foreign Minister Nafti met Russian Ambassador Zolotov to follow up on the Russia-Africa summit and strengthen bilateral ties.

item.title: Tunisia plans 32.6 billion dinars investment for 2027
item.description: The country aims for a 14.1% increase in total investments, with 1.2 billion dinars allocated to road infrastructure.

item.title: Tunisian court sentences Riad Ben Fadhl to 20 years
item.description: 18 other defendants received nine-year sentences in a corruption and money laundering case.
